item.title: Lagos man seeks court intervention over delayed reading of father’s will
item.description: A Lagos-based man, Mr Kolawole Adesina, has appealed for judicial intervention over prolonged delays in the reading of his late father’s will, a development he says has deepened a long-running family dispute and hindered the orderly administration of the estate. item.title: ‘They’re following what you taught them’ — Odinkalu mocks Malami
item.description: Former chairman of the National Human Rights Commission, Chidi Odinkalu, has criticised former Attorney-General of the Federation Abubakar Malami over his recent claims that the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission is acting politically in its dealings with him. item.title: Kwara govt offers clarifications on video linking officials to bandits
item.description: The Kwara State Government has denied reports circulating on social media that the Nigerian Army arrested armed bandits in Ifelodun Local Government Area of the state, describing the claims as false and misleading. item.title: AFCON 2025: Super Eagles camp swells with Lookman, Ajayi, others’ arrival
item.description: Ten players are now in the Super Eagles camp in Cairo following the arrival of Semi Ajayi, Ademola Lookman, and Bright Osayi-Samuel. The latest arrivals also include Igho Ogbu, Amas Obasogie, and Tochukwu Nnadi. They joined the quartet joined of Francis Uzoho, Stanley Nwabali, Fisayo Dele-Bashiru, Ebenezer Akinsanmiro, who are the early arrivals in camp. item.title: Edo mortuary attendant arrested over alleged removal of corpse organs
item.description: A mortuary attendant in the Upper Sakponba area of Ikpoba-Okha Local Government Area, Edo State, has been arrested by police following allegations that vital organs were removed from a body at Akugbe Mortuary. According to reports obtained, the discovery sparked outrage among the deceased’s relatives, who accused the attendant of harvesting organs from the corpse. item.title: Troops neutralise over 14 terrorists, intercept ransom in nationwide operations
item.description: Troops of the Nigerian Army have recorded major operational gains nationwide, killing over 14 terrorists and intercepted N9 million ransom in the last 48 hours. A credible source at Army Headquarters told the News Agency of Nigeria, NAN, that troops also apprehended several suspects and rescued many kidnapped victims in coordinated operations across multiple theatres.
